[TAB-FULL:v1p435/r3] TAB-FULL, d. 310 · بعضهم | reports | Another view limits the passage to disbelieving and hypocritical People of the Book: they broke the Torah covenant to follow Muhammad and disclose what they knew about him.
[TAB-FULL:v1p435/r4] TAB-FULL, d. 310 · بعضهم | reports | A broader view says all polytheists, disbelievers, and hypocrites break the covenant of monotheism and prophetic proof by rejecting what evidence shows to be true.
